poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE MAGIC IS ALWAYS AN ILLUSION OF LIGHT
poetryFrame.rightVertical: REALITY LIVES BEYOND THE GOLDEN SCREENING
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS STORY HAS NO HAPPY ENDING, JUST DUST.
sonnetLines: The curtain drops on gilded lies,
We search for stars in painted skies,
And find the hollow where nothing breathes.
They sold us myth, a perfect grace,
But love is messy, frayed, and deep.
It leaves its scars upon this place,
Where fragile promises fail to keep.
No kiss can mend what time has torn,
The fairy tale must learn to fade.
A truth that waits beyond the morn,
In shadows where the vows were made.
We walk away from shining dust,
Trusting only our own hard thrust.

lyrics.text: I'm mad at Disney, Disney
They tricked me, tricked me
Had me wishing on a shooting star
But now I'm twenty-something
I still know nothing
'Bout who I am or what I'm not
So call me a pessimist
But I don't believe in it
Finding a true love's kiss is bullsh-
'Cause I felt sad love, I felt bad love
Sometimes happy love (happy love)
Turns into giving up (giving up)
I felt hurt love 'bout the word love
What the hell is love supposed to feel like?
What the hell is love? What the hell is love?
What the hell is love supposed to feel like?
(Carry me away to a castle)
(Where we will live happily ever after)
My fairy grandma warned me
Cinderella's story only ended in a bad divorce
The prince ain't sleeping when he takes his sleeping beauty
To the motel on his snow white horse
So call me a pessimist
But I don't believe in it
Finding a true love's kiss is bullsh-
'Cause I felt sad love, I felt bad love
Sometimes happy love (happy love)
Turns into giving up (I'm giving up)
I felt hurt love 'bout the word love
What the hell is love supposed to feel like?
What the hell is love? What the hell is love?
What the hell is love supposed to feel like?
What the hell is love? What the hell is love?
What the hell is love supposed to feel like?
I'm mad at Disney, Disney
They tricked me, tricked me
No more wishing on a shooting star
